title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 62 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 62)

content.overview: Section 62 preserves conciliation proceedings initiated under sections 61 to 81 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act as they stood before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023, allowing those proceedings to continue under the earlier regime.

content.study:
Section 62 — Saving

Section 62 preserves conciliation proceedings initiated under sections 61 to 81 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act as they stood before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023, allowing those proceedings to continue under the earlier regime.

This section must be read with the Mediation Act, 2023 amendments and the statutory saving provision. Counsel must distinguish current mediation law from legacy conciliation proceedings preserved by section 62.
